L11·N2972unmasked layer
This neuron responds weakly/positively to ordinary, hard-to-predict words in personal-narrative prose (pronouns and person-referring nouns like "he", "wanted", "child", "diva", "Dali"), and is most strongly *suppressed* on the obligatory final token of a fixed collocation/idiom ("take **advantage** of", "making the **most** of", "life-aff**irm**ing", "fl**ing**) — i.e. it tracks predictability of the token given a locked-in multiword expression.
